content_sections.heading: About IIT Hyderabad Project Associate – I Recruitment
content_sections.text: The notice comes from the Department of Mathematics, Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad, Kandi, Sangareddy, Telangana. The post sits under a research project funded by the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF). The Principal Investigator is Dr. Neeraj Kumar, Associate Professor, Department of Mathematics.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: M.Sc./Integrated M.Sc. in Mathematics, a four-year Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, or an equivalent degree in a relevant discipline. Strong background in algebra, preferably with knowledge of commutative algebra. Familiarity with programming languages, particularly C/C++. Preference will be given to candidates with knowledge of commutative algebra, considering the research objectives of the project. CSIR-UGC NET, GATE or a national-level examination selection is not listed as a condition to apply; it decides which pay applies.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: HRA will not be provided if hostel accommodation at IIT Hyderabad is availed. Hostel accommodation is subject to availability and applicable institute regulations. The appointment will be purely contractual and will continue until 15 October 2027, subject to satisfactory performance and availability of project funds.

rows.candidate: Selected through CSIR-UGC NET (including Lectureship/Assistant Professorship) or GATE; or through a selection process via national-level examinations conducted by Central Government departments and their agencies/institutions

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Hyderabad Project Associate – I
content_sections.text: Prepare one single PDF file containing the documents listed below. Email the PDF to the Principal Investigator, Dr. Neeraj Kumar, at [email protected] . Write the subject line as: Application for Project Associate - I Position. Updated CV, including UG and PG marks/CGPA. Proof of qualification in CSIR-UGC NET, GATE, or other applicable national-level examinations (if any). The notice says interested candidates are encouraged to apply at the earliest.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting will be based on academic qualifications and suitability for the project. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted by email for an online interview. The position will remain open until a suitable candidate is selected.

rows.date: Rolling basis until the position is filled

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Associate – I posts are there at IIT Hyderabad?
faq.answer: There is 01 vacancy for Project Associate – I in the Department of Mathematics, IIT Hyderabad, under the ANRF-funded project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Hyderabad Project Associate – I post?
faq.answer: No fixed last date is printed. Applications are accepted and reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IIT Hyderabad Project Associate – I post?
faq.answer: M.Sc./Integrated M.Sc. in Mathematics, a four-year Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, or an equivalent degree in a relevant discipline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the Project Associate – I?
faq.answer: It is ₹37,000 + 30% HRA per month for candidates selected through CSIR-UGC NET or GATE, or through national-level examinations of Central Government departments and agencies. Other selected candidates get ₹30,000 + 30% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, 30% HRA is stated along with both pay amounts. HRA will not be provided if hostel accommodation at IIT Hyderabad is availed.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the IIT Hyderabad Project Associate – I post?
faq.answer: Email an updated CV and any NET/GATE or national-level examination proof, as a single PDF, to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. What subject line should the application email carry?
faq.answer: The subject line should be: Application for Project Associate - I Position.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Applications are shortlisted on academic qualifications and suitability for the project. Only shortlisted candidates are contacted by email for an online interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is the Project Associate – I post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely contractual and continues until 15 October 2027, subject to satisfactory performance and availability of project funds.

faq.question: Q10. Is knowledge of commutative algebra required?
faq.answer: It is desirable, not essential. Preference will be given to candidates with knowledge of commutative algebra, and familiarity with C/C++ is also desirable.
